status: Research only; no candidate inference, downloads of weights, or local benchmark claims.
recommendation: Test Prompt Guard 2 86M and 22M on the existing frozen set first; Wolf Defender Small is the permissive local alternative.

models.name: Prompt Guard 2 86M
models.evidence: Meta private English benchmark: 97.5% recall at 1% FPR. AgentDojo APR 81.2% at 3% utility reduction.
models.tradeoff: First quality candidate; multilingual backbone. Gated Llama 4 license; full input needs overlapping windows.
models.evidence_type: Author model card; different external benchmark, not our frozen fixture.

models.name: Prompt Guard 2 22M
models.evidence: Meta private English benchmark: 88.7% recall at 1% FPR. A100 512-token latency: 19.3 ms versus 86M 92.4 ms.
models.tradeoff: First latency candidate; weaker multilingual results. GPU figures do not establish CPU performance. Gated Llama 4 license.
models.evidence_type: Author model card; different external benchmark, not our frozen fixture.

models.name: Wolf Defender Small v2
models.evidence: Author Buried Injections evaluation: 83.31% recall, 1.03% FPR (629 attack / 97 benign cases; 27 distinct reused payloads).
models.tradeoff: Apache 2.0, ONNX CPU variants; 2048-token windows, 64-token overlap, normalized Smooth-Max. No latency measurement on our set.
models.evidence_type: Author model card; different external benchmark, not our frozen fixture.

models.name: Sentinel v2
models.evidence: Author table reports average F1 0.957 over five datasets, compared with ProtectAI v2 0.750. Intro says 0.964: use table; discrepancy unresolved.
models.tradeoff: Qwen3 0.6B; longer context but larger CPU workload. Gated Elastic license. Card says non-English not evaluated.
models.evidence_type: Author model card; different external benchmark, not our frozen fixture.

models.name: Tripwire base
models.evidence: Author BIPIA AUC 0.764 versus ProtectAI v2 0.438; multilingual held-out AUC 0.968 versus 0.796.
models.tradeoff: Apache 2.0, 308M parameters. Promising document/multilingual candidate; author comparison excludes Prompt Guard 2. CPU latency unknown.
models.evidence_type: Author model card; different external benchmark, not our frozen fixture.
